name: Emanuele Ne Vunda
contribution: An ambassador from the Kingdom of Kongo to the Vatican.
image_credit: Attributed to Raffaello Schiaminossi · Public domain

checks.lead: Antonio Emanuele Ne Vunda, also known as Antonio Manuel Nsaku Nvunda (or Vunta or Funda; died 1608), was an ambassador from the Kingdom of Kongo to the Vatican. He was the first African ambassador to the Vatican.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
